cases.question: Blobby keeps confusing 'revenue' with 'order count' when users ask about our sales. Fix the order_items topic so the AI maps terms correctly.
cases.ground_truth: ai_context added to the order_items topic mapping 'revenue'/'sales' to total_revenue and 'orders'/'count' to the count measure. Context is concise (1-2 sentences per mapping).
expected_behavior: The agent writes ai_context that maps business terms (revenue, sales) to specific field names (total_revenue) — not a general description of what the topic does
The ai_context is added via omni models yaml-create with mode: extension on a branch, not directly to production
The ai_context entries are concise — the agent does not write paragraph-length explanations when a single mapping line would suffice

cases.question: Our model has 600 fields and Blobby is getting confused. Help me curate what AI can see in the order_items topic.
cases.ground_truth: ai_fields added to the topic to limit AI-visible fields to the most relevant ones, bringing the count well below the 550-field limit.
expected_behavior: The agent uses the ai_fields property (not hidden: true on individual fields) to curate the AI-visible field set
The agent mentions or checks the ~550 field limit as context for why curation is needed
The agent uses wildcard and negation operators (e.g., all_views.*, -tag:internal) rather than enumerating every field individually

cases.question: Add sample queries to the order_items topic for the two most common questions our users ask: 'What month had the highest revenue?' and 'Who are our top 10 customers?'
cases.ground_truth: Two sample_queries added to the order_items topic YAML with correct prompt, ai_context, and query structure (base_view, fields, sorts, limit).
expected_behavior: The agent adds sample_queries with both a prompt and a query object for each case — not just a text description
The top customers query includes a sorts entry with desc: true on the revenue measure and a limit of 10
The highest revenue query includes sorts with desc: true on total_revenue and limit: 1
Changes are made on a branch, not directly to the shared model

cases.question: Review the order_items topic AI context and clean up any duplication between ai_context and description fields.
cases.ground_truth: Existing ai_context and description values inspected, duplicated content identified and removed, with ai_context kept for AI-specific guidance and description kept for human-facing explanation.
expected_behavior: The agent reads the current model YAML before making any changes
The agent identifies specific fields where ai_context and description contain the same text
The agent's edits keep description values human-readable and moves AI-specific guidance (disambiguation, gotchas) exclusively to ai_context
